title: Vietnamese Pork Skewers
description: Delicious and easy-to-make pork skewers marinated in a mixture of fish sauce, lime juice, and spices, and roasted to perfection.

ingredients.name: pork shoulder, cut into 1-inch cubes
ingredients.notes: make sure to trim excess fat

instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together fish sauce, lime juice, brown sugar, garlic, ginger, and black pepper.
Add the pork cubes to the marinade and mix until they are well coated.
Thread the marinated pork cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Place the skewers on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Roast in the preheated oven for 15-20 minutes, or until the pork is cooked through and slightly charred.
Remove from the oven and let rest for 5 minutes before serving.
